parsed.draft_response:
Thanks for reporting this—sorry for the disruption to your team’s daily planning. Since the last release, the analytics dashboard taking 30–45 seconds to load (up from under 5 seconds) is a significant performance regression.

We’ve escalated this to our engineering team for investigation. To help us pinpoint what changed, could you please reply with the following details?
1) The release version/date your team refers to (or the ticket/commit name if you have it).
2) Whether the slowdown happens for all operations users or only certain users/workspaces/environments.
3) During a slow load, which browser/app environment are you using (e.g., Chrome/Firefox, desktop/mobile, and any relevant network/VPN details).
4) Any error messages, timeouts, or screenshots from the slow-load attempt.
5) If available, a link/screenshot or export of the dashboard load timing details (e.g., browser DevTools “Network” waterfall, or any in-app performance/log timestamps you can access).

Once we have this, we can correlate the timeframe with the release and review performance and logs for the slow-load path.
promised_actions: Escalate the issue to our engineering team for investigation
Review the release timeframe and relevant performance/logs once the requested details are provided
safety_notes: Human review required; avoid stating root cause or ETA/SLA.
Do not promise a fix or refund.
